extracted.intended_audience: journalists, stations, and news organizations submitting entries to the Edward R. Murrow Awards (RTDNA)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and entry rules for submitting work to RTDNA's Edward R. Murrow Awards, including eligibility, formatting, link requirements, and category/division restrictions. Focused on how entrants must prepare and submit entries so they are accepted and judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review division and category information
rubrics_metrics.description: If it's your first time entering, spend some time reviewing division and category information before you begin your entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants—especially first-time entrants—should check the divisions and categories to ensure they submit to the correct category and understand any category-specific rules before preparing entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry limits per organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Only one Newscast entry and one Overall Excellence entry can be entered per organization. Stations or organizations can enter multiple entries in all other categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizations must observe the per-organization caps for Newscast and Overall Excellence; other categories do not have the same single-entry restriction for organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on entering the same item in multiple categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Stations cannot enter an entry in the Hard News Reporting category and the Feature Reporting category. Organizations can enter the same entry (or parts of the same entry) in all other categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is a specific prohibition on submitting the same piece to both Hard News Reporting and Feature Reporting; otherwise, submitting the same piece or parts of it in multiple categories is allowed for organizations unless otherwise stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict enforcement of category time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Judges are instructed to only watch or listen up to the allotted time for each entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time limits for each category are strictly enforced during judging—entries exceeding the time allowed will not be considered beyond the cutoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single, functioning link required
rubrics_metrics.description: Your entry must be submitted in one single, functioning link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries distributed across multiple links will not be accepted. If submitting a composite entry you must edit separate stories together into one link unless the category explicitly permits multiple links (Digital category is an exception).

rubrics_metrics.name: Composite entry handling / Digital category exception
rubrics_metrics.description: If your entry is a composite entry, you must edit your separate stories together, unless the category specifies multiple links will be accepted. (The exception to this rule is the Digital category.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow category-specific instructions: most categories require one compiled link for composites; check Digital category rules where multiple links may be allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link availability and disqualification consequence
rubrics_metrics.description: Entrants are responsible for making sure that entry links are active through at least the end of the award year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the link is not active at the time of judging, the entry will be disqualified immediately and entry fees will not be refunded. RTDNA encourages entrants to keep links active permanently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent journalist eligibility and market/medium rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Independent journalists can enter; RTDNA encourages all journalists to enter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Independent entrants should enter in the market and medium where the piece was first broadcast.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-English entry requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-English entries are required to include subtitles or English-translated scripts with their piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide either embedded subtitles or an English-translated script accompanying the entry so judges can evaluate content not in English.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online-only submission method
rubrics_metrics.description: All entries must be submitted via the online awards platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RTDNA does not accept mailed entries; use the official online submission system for all entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership rate requires approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Memberships require approval from our team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you joined as a member but do not see member pricing, wait until normal business hours to allow membership approval and then revisit the cart to see updated pricing.
